runtime.name: python
runtime.source: docs do not say; a newcomer installs the current LTS

prereqs.command: command -v uv >/dev/null || { if command -v pip >/dev/null || command -v pip3 >/dev/null; then (pip install uv || pip3 install uv); else apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl >/dev/null && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | env UV_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin sh; fi; }

knownFailures.cause: `uv` is not installed; the docs assume it is.
